name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-a0
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: private-a0
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M hdet hM hN hP hmd
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h' : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h1 : m.S * M * N ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h' hN
  have h2 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hdet
  have key : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ - N * M * m.S + m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h3 : N * M * m.S = m.S * M * N := by grind
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-a0
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hP hS
  have key : 4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.modeDet N M = (2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
    grind
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2 :=
    Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sub_nonneg.mpr hS) (Int.sq_nonneg _))
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h2 : 4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.modeDet N M < 0 :=
    Int.mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (Int.mul_pos (by decide) hP) (Int.not_le.mp h)
  rw [key] at h2
  exact absurd h1 (Int.not_le.mpr h2)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

theorem D01 : ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdDD V C < Scope.hdHD V C := by
  intro V C h
  unfold Scope.hdDD Scope.hdHD
  omega
statement: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdDD V C < Scope.hdHD V C

author: private-a0
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN h hd
  have e : m.modeDet N M = M * (m.detJ * M - m.S * N) + N * N * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ N * N * (m.Du * m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN) h
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have h3 : 0 ≤ m.detJ * M - m.S * N := by omega
  have h4 : 0 ≤ M * (m.detJ * M - m.S * N) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt hM) h3
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N

theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M htr hdet hDu hDv hM hN hle
  have h1 := T03 m N M htr hDu hDv hM hN
  have h2 : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h3 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hdet
  have h4 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := Int.mul_nonneg hN (by omega)
  exact ⟨h1, by omega⟩
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
